name: agent-notify
description: Deploy-to-Cloudflare email notifications for your AI agents (HTTP + MCP)

TO_ADDRESS.description: Where alerts go. Must be a **verified destination address** in Email Routing.

FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender, e.g. `alerts@yourdomain.com`. Must be on a domain with **Email Routing enabled** in this account.

KV.description: Stores your generated access token. Leave the default.
